overview_description.description: Dhahaby is a fintech platform focused on transforming gold and other precious assets into accessible financial liquidity through Shariah-compliant lending infrastructure. The company enables licensed financial institutions to offer instant loans secured by physical and digital gold, using AI-assisted asset valuation, insured custody, blockchain-backed transparency, and certified jeweller networks.
